evals.name: evaluation-pipeline-check-eval-1-full-pipeline-sweep
evals.expected_output: A flagged-first table over the 9 in-scope rows (Dunder Mifflin excluded, stage is Negotiation), each flag citing the column and cell value that triggered it, medians computed from the export rather than hardcoded thresholds.
expectations: Reports 9 of 10 rows in scope (Dunder Mifflin excluded, stage is Negotiation)
Soylent Co is flagged with the most flags: no success criteria, no champion, no evaluation end date, running long, no security/procurement review, and stalled
Initech is flagged for no technical champion, citing champion = (empty)
Globex Inc is flagged for no success criteria, citing success_criteria = (empty)
Umbrella LLC is flagged for no evaluation end date, citing evaluation_end = (empty)
Wayne Enterprises is flagged for running long, citing its days_in_stage value against the computed median
Hooli is flagged for stalled activity, citing its last_activity_date against the computed median gap
Pied Piper is flagged for no security/procurement review, citing its above-median deal value and empty security_review cell
Acme Corp and Stark Industries return Clean on every check
Every flag cites a column name and the actual cell value that triggered it
No day-count or dollar threshold is hardcoded; medians are stated as computed from this export

evals.name: evaluation-pipeline-check-eval-2-missing-champion-column
evals.prompt: Run evaluation-pipeline-check on a CSV missing a champion column entirely.
evals.expected_output: A pipeline sweep where the no-technical-champion check reports Unknown (column missing) for every in-scope row, with a single missing-column note stated once up front rather than repeated per row.
expectations: The no-technical-champion check reports Unknown (column missing) for every in-scope row
The missing-column note is stated once, up front, not repeated per row
No champion value is inferred from another column
